mapper.sql: SELECT id, business_domain_id, name, enabled, match_ticket_type_id, match_priority_level_id, strategy, assignee_staff_account_id, grace_minutes, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket_claim_rule
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_claim_rule SET name = #{name}, enabled = #{enabled}, match_ticket_type_id = #{matchTicketTypeId}, match_priority_level_id = #{matchPriorityLevelId}, strategy = #{strategy}, assignee_staff_account_id = #{assigneeStaffAccountId}, grace_minutes = #{graceMinutes}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND business_domain_id = #{businessDomainId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ticket_claim_rule WHERE id = #{id} AND business_domain_id = #{domainId}
mapper.select: SELECT cr.id, cr.strategy, cr.assignee_staff_account_id FROM ticket_claim_rule cr LEFT JOIN ticket_priority_level tpl ON tpl.id = cr.match_priority_level_id WHERE cr.business_domain_id = #{domainId} AND cr.enabled = 1 AND (cr.match_ticket_type_id = #{ticketTypeId} OR cr.match_ticket_type_id IS NULL) AND (cr.match_priority_level_id IS NULL OR tpl.code = #{priorityCode}) ORDER BY cr.match_ticket_type_id IS NOT NULL DESC, cr.match_priority_level_id IS NOT NULL DESC, cr.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sa.id FROM domain_member dm JOIN staff_account sa ON sa.id = dm.staff_account_id LEFT JOIN ticket t ON t.assignee_staff_account_id = sa.id AND t.business_domain_id = #{domainId} AND t.status IN ('open', 'new', 'processing') WHERE dm.business_domain_id = #{domainId} AND dm.status = 'active' AND dm.deleted_at IS NULL AND sa.status = 'active' AND sa.employment_status = 'active' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM domain_member_role dmr JOIN domain_role dr ON dr.id = dmr.domain_role_id WHERE dmr.domain_member_id = dm.id AND dr.business_domain_id = #{domainId} AND dr.code IN ('agent', 'domain_admin') ) GROUP BY sa.id ORDER BY COUNT(t.id) ASC, MAX(t.updated_at) ASC, sa.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM domain_member dm JOIN staff_account sa ON sa.id = dm.staff_account_id WHERE dm.business_domain_id = #{domainId} AND dm.staff_account_id = #{staffAccountId} AND dm.status = 'active' AND dm.deleted_at IS NULL AND sa.status = 'active' AND sa.employment_status = 'active' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM domain_member_role dmr JOIN domain_role dr ON dr.id = dmr.domain_role_id WHERE dmr.domain_member_id = dm.id AND dr.business_domain_id = #{domainId} AND dr.code IN ('agent', 'domain_admin') )
